summary: Silver Point Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting the unregistered sale of 683,801 common shares at $26.88 per share for $18.38 million under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D/S, plus a regular monthly dividend of $0.1575 per share. This is a routine capital raise and dividend declaration, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or strategic action is involved. The filing is purely operational for the fund. What to watch: no further event is expected.
